text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Over 40 percent of Portuguese backs regionalisation, while some 30 percent opposes, says an opinion poll.
- Opposition Social Democratic Party (PSD) demands Prime Minister Antonio Guterres take part in parliamentary debate on security on Tuesday.
- Property owners will have to pay more tax if the government approves a suggestion from a group of academics from Tecnical University of Lisbon.
- Two Spanish electricity companies, Endesa and Iberdrola, eye a stake in Portugal's soon-to-be-privatised EDP.
- Passenger car sales have still not fully recovered, the industry association says.
- Portuguese stock market may rise more than 15 percent in 1997, analysts say.
- Banco Internacional do Funchal decides against buying buying Credit Lyonnais's Portuguese subsidiary.
